description: A massive animated conflagration, crackling like burning logs as it moves.

special_attacks.description: Wicked flames erupt from the spirit of fire!

special_attacks.monster_message: Oppressive heat radiates from the spirit of fire.

description: A large plantlike creature with a gaping, toothy maw and numerous vines.  A hideous smell permeates the air around it.

special_attacks.monster_message: A strange vapor emanates from the moruboru.

description: A tall, robed figure twisted into a mockery of the human form, brandishing a strange golden talisman.  You feel an otherworldly presence about it.

special_attacks.description: A beam of lightning arcs from the host of the archon's symbol of judgment!

special_attacks.monster_message: You briefly sense the otherworldly presence controlling the host, as it glares at %3$s.

description: A massive, reptilian creature with batlike wings.  Its decaying body looks like it was halfway through being dissected, and the membranes of its wings are in tatters.  You wonder how such a large beast could fly in the first place, let alone in that condition.
//: Also has less mass than expected due to being in very poor shape.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: The %1$s slashes at you with a wicked claw!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: The %1$s slashes at <npcname> with a wicked claw!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: The %1$s tries to slash at you, but fails to penetrate your armor!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: The %1$s tries to slash <npcname>, but fails to penetrate their armor!

special_attacks.description: Wicked flames erupt from the dracolich's mouth!

special_attacks.monster_message: A stream of charred gore erupts from the dracolich's mouth!

description: A huge mutated worm living deep underground.  It has a round, gaping mouth lined with dagger-like teeth, and its flesh is slick with bubbling blue slime.
A charred zombie covered with bony plates, spikes, and protrusions.  Moves stiffly, but swiftly.

A putrid amalgamation of body parts from humans and other creatures have fused together in this aberration of flesh.  The eyes of all the heads dart about rapidly and the mouths form a chorus of groaning screams.

//: Formerly a vanilla monster that never actually spawned anywhere, they got the axe instead of ever actually getting a place to spawn in.
description: A pale hairless man with an impressive athletic physique.  Its lidless eyes are totally black, and seeping with blood.
An amorphous black creature, detaching and sprouting tentacles without any apparent pause.

This undead canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.  This walking suit of bone seems to be controlled by a net of veins and sinews which pulse with glistening black goo.

A monstrous overgrowth of ossified tissue has replaced this zombie's rotting skin with an organic armor of dense bone.  Large clumps of black goo seep from its joints as it shambles aimlessly, with sickening crackling sounds filling the surrounding air.
A twisting spot in the air, with some kind of morphing mass at its center.

A huge, slimy worm-like creature.  Its pale, flattened head drips an oily mucus as it breaches the ground, searching for prey.  Its pinkish mouth opens and closes, revealing long fangs glistening with ropey strands of saliva, which leave smoldering stains wherever they drip.

special_attacks.monster_message: The summoned yugg fires a dart at %3$s!

description: This is some form of otherworldly hound.  Lean and hungry-looking, its twisted red flesh is stretched tightly across its misshapen, angular frame.  Loping grotesquely along, its unusually long neck stretches forward, its skull-like head near the ground as it sniffs out its prey.  Its foulness partially veiled by some arcane force, it seems to almost flicker in and out of your perceptions as if you were looking at it from the corner of your vision.
//: a good candidate for an alien anatomy harvest

description: A creeping mobile plant, as tall as a moose.  It has a single bark-covered stalk supporting a flowery head with a paralyzing sting concealed within.  Nature is healing.

special_attacks.monster_message: The summoned triffid fires a dart at %3$s!

//: Formerly a vanilla monster that never actually spawned anywhere, they got the axe instead of ever actually getting a place to spawn in.
description: A tall and slender man lacking skin and any normalcy of countenance.  Wings of muscle curl forth from its back and a third eye dominates the forehead.

This is some sort of great viperine creature, possessed of a curiously distorted head and massive clawed appendages.  It partially supports itself with the aid of black, rubbery wings of monstrous dimensions.  The wings beat slowly like an eagle while the body coils through the air like how an eel swims in water.

An alien creature of uncertain origin.  Its shapeless pink body bears numerous sets of paired appendages of unknown function, and a pair of ribbed, membranous wings which seem to be quite useless.  Its odd, vaguely pyramid-shaped head bristles with numerous wavering antennae, and it moves with an uncanny fluidity on its many legs.
A half-polypous, utterly alien creature.  It's only partly material and has the ability to fly, despite the absence of wings.  It produces strange whistling noises which dominate every other sound.

A gargantuan protoplasmic blob, constantly reshaping, forming new pseudopods seemingly at will.  All over its body are eyes that form and disappear.  The rapid and chaotic way it reconstitutes itself gives the impression of it boiling over with some kind of primordial fury.

An animate shadow.  Looking like nothing more than an errant patch of normal shadow, it draws your attention by the way it moves subtly and whispers softly in the back of your mind.  Strange intrusive thoughts accompany the quiet murmur, trying to forcefully supplant your own.

This is an animate shadow.  Looking like nothing more than an errant patch of normal shadow, it draws your attention by the way it moves subtly and whispers softly in the back of your mind.  Strange intrusive thoughts accompany the quiet murmur, awakening your most horrific memories and fears.

death_function.message: The %s wavers and fades away, a mere illusion.

description: This is an animate shadow in the form of a long and sinuous snake.  Translucent and dark, it weaves silently through the air, wriggling and flexing as it moves.
This is an animate shadow in the form of a long and sinuous snake.  Translucent and dark, it weaves silently through the air, wriggling and flexing as it moves.

death_function.message: The %s wavers and fades away, a mere illusion.

description: A two-meter-long centipede with a menacing set of venom-dripping mandibles and a worrying number of grabbing appendages, moving swiftly on dozens of spindly legs.  It has a pair of small compound eyes, but seems to mostly orient itself with its antennae.
//: 10-20 dmg, 4 hits to max intensity, 5 hits to max duration

description: A tall living shadow with a humanoid silhouette.  Six projections of shifting darkness disrupt its outline, giving the impression of a six-winged figure.  An outright tangible aura of malevolence radiates from it.

special_attacks.description: A radiant beam of otherworldly energy lances out from the seraphic shade's body!

special_attacks.monster_message: You briefly sense the seraphic shade's otherworldly presence, as it glares at %3$s.

description: A wavering living shadow with a humanoid silhouette.  Six translucent, shadowy projections disrupt its outline, giving the impression of a six-winged figure.  A faint aura of malevolence radiates from it.

death_function.message: The %s's wavers and vanishes, dispelling the illusion.

description: A hulking mass of parts running off anomalous technology using the power of the Beyond, tamed and reborn to serve humanity once again.  Equipped with an exotic laser weapon and retaining some of the tricks its autonomous version possessed, it's ineffective against certain anomalous monsters and robots, but fast and deadly in the right hands.  A protective barrier also shields the pilot from exposure to fire, acid, or toxic gas.  Powered by a completely bespoke essence amplification cell, which can act like a UPS while installed in this mech.
//: Intentionally abnormally lightweight while active, 1% of what its actual weight should be.

description: What appears to be a prototype model of Anomaly Recon Mech, moving with the same malevolent purpose as the many rogue machines left in the wake of the Cataclysm.  Autonomous and armed with an exotic laser weapon and other arcane tricks, this mechanical abomination has neither need nor want for a pilot.
//: Intentionally abnormally lightweight while active, 1% of what its actual weight should be.

special_attacks.description: The Autonomous Anomaly Recon Mech fires a radiant beam of otherworldly energy!

special_attacks.monster_message: The Autonomous Anomaly Recon Mech launches a ghostly blue flare, illuminating %3$s with ethereal light!

description: Torn robes cover a shuffling human form, still breathing despite its zombie-like unsteadiness.  Gripped by raving madness, a strange aura gathers around it as it clutches a tarnished silver talisman.

special_attacks.monster_message: The air wavers as the maddened wanderer raises its talisman!

description: A cloak of metal scales obscures this humanoid figure, heavy breaths revealing it to still be among the living.  Gripped by raving madness, bloodshot eyes glower from under a metal mask, as it grasps a silver-decorated war hammer.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "Ave martello!"  The maddened hunter raises its hammer high!
special_attacks.description: The maddened hunter's hammer gives off a blinding flash!

description: Dark robes and a heavy fur mantle conceal a human figure, still breathing despite looking to be on the edge of death.  Gripped by raving madness, it desperately clutches a golden talisman that crackles with electricity.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "May He forge your chains!"  The maddened keeper raises its symbol of judgment!
special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the maddened keeper's symbol of judgment!

description: Clad in well-worn leather armor, this wretch is still alive and breathing despite its unsteady gait and bloodshot gaze.  Gripped by raving madness, flames dance around the gem-adorned staff it uses as a walking stick.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "Burn!"  The maddened sanguinist levels its hellfire staff!
special_attacks.description: Flames erupt from the maddened sanguinist's hellfire staff!
